title: trichomanes javanicum var. boryanum
intro: Trichomanes javanicum var. boryanum, commonly known as the Java fern, is a species of fern in the family Hymenophyllaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Java fern include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit potential anticancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Trichomanes javanicum var. boryanum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
